blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Marcos met with executives of US logistics giant FedEx in Singapore on Thursday, where the company raised the possibility of further expanding its Philippine operations amid an ongoing upgrade of its Clark Gateway Hub in Pampanga. FedEx Airline and International President and CEO Richard Smith said the company may need another expansion if its current growth continues, according to the Presidential News Desk (PND). The discussion took place on the sidelines of Marcos’ participation in the 24th Forbes Global CEO Conference.
